## Checklist

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated for library changes
- [ ] New variables are declared in `databricks.yml` AND consumed somewhere
- [ ] New resources are in the correct single-concern `resources/*.yml` file
- [ ] `conf/` registry changes have matching registry meta-tests
- [ ] No environment-suffixed names, no logic in `transforms/` bodies
- [ ] ADR added/updated if a design decision changed
